subject: Kickoff: POC calendar Tetris — aligning owners, success criteria, and procurement
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Adi Sharma <adi.sharma@finlytics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC kickoff — initial availability (30/60 min options)

Hi Adi — great to have FinLytics moving toward a POC. Quick note to get a kickoff on the calendar so we can align owners and define success criteria. Proposed windows (PST):

- Tue 2026-10-19, 10:00–10:45 — AE+SE walkthrough + initial infra checklist
- Tue 2026-10-19, 14:00–15:00 — extended session (includes procurement/security)
- Wed 2026-10-20, 09:00–09:45 — short sync if earlier slots don't work

Attaching a one-pager with the POC success criteria draft and a rough agenda. If none of these work, tell us a few windows that do and we’ll Tetris it.

Owners from our side:
- Ben Carter (AE) — commercial/goals and timeline
- Monica Patel (SE) — technical kickoff and integration plan
- Evelyn Hart (CS) — success metrics and post-POC handoffs

Action: please confirm preferred slot and cc your procurement/security contacts if you want them on the extended session.

Regards,
Ben
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: POC-success-criteria-v1.pdf (PDF, 2 pages)

From: Adi Sharma <adi.sharma@finlytics.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@finlytics.com>, security@finlytics.com
Date: 2026-10-18T12:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — initial availability (30/60 min options)

Ben — thanks. All three windows are close; unfortunately Tue morning we have a production release and Tue afternoon our engineering leadership is booked. Wed 09:00 would work for a short sync but we actually need the SE and procurement/security in the first meeting to unblock procurement paperwork. Can you do Wed 09:00–10:30 instead? If not, Thu 10/21 11:00–12:30 PST is also possible.

Looping in Priya from procurement and security@finlytics.com — Priya, could you confirm if the procurement kickoff can be a 30-minute touch on the first day or do you need a separate slot?

Thanks,
Adi Sharma
Senior Engineering Manager — Platform
Adi.Sharma@finlytics.com

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Adi Sharma <adi.sharma@finlytics.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@finlytics.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, security@finlytics.com
Date: 2026-10-18T13:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — initial availability (30/60 min options)

On 10/18/26 12:04, Adi Sharma wrote:
> Can you do Wed 09:00–10:30 instead? If not, Thu 10/21 11:00–12:30 PST is also possible.

Adi — Wed 09:00–10:30 PST works for me. That gives us 90 minutes to cover: environment prerequisites, account provisioning (service accounts/keys), demo plan with sample data, and an initial run-through of the first workload.

Proposed internal owner split for the 90-min kickoff:
- 0:00–0:10 — Introductions and goals (Ben)
- 0:10–0:35 — Architecture & infra checklist (Monica)
- 0:35–1:05 — Hands-on demo + integration steps (Monica + Adi engs)
- 1:05–1:20 — Success criteria and timeline, handoffs (Evelyn)
- 1:20–1:30 — Procurement/security Q&A (Priya/security)

I’ll update the agenda draft in the shared Drive link and include a short runbook for provisioning. Ben — can you confirm that we’ll have a temporary test tenant ready (or do you need FinLytics to create it)? Also attaching a doc with the proposed acceptance checks (POC-success-criteria-v1.pdf).

—Monica
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: draft-agenda-20261019.gdoc (Google Doc link placeholder)

From: Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@finlytics.com>
To: Adi Sharma <adi.sharma@finlytics.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@finlytics.com, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-19T08:57:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — initial availability (30/60 min options)

Thanks for the plan. Procurement can join for the last 20 minutes for contract/terms overview and a list of required items. Two quick notes from our side before Wed: 

1) For any trial or temporary tenant we need a short MS SOW or trial addendum that clarifies data handling and retention (we cannot have shared production keys).
2) Security team requested an architecture diagram and a list of required network endpoints 24 hours before the kickoff. They prefer a separate brief (15 min) with a security engineer if time allows during the 90-min slot.

If you can provide the SOW template and the diagram by Tue EOD (2026-10-19 17:00 PST) that would keep everything green. Otherwise we should shift to Thu 11:00–12:30.

Regards,
Priya Reddy
Head of Procurement | FinLytics
procurement@finlytics.com

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com>
To: Adi Sharma <adi.sharma@finlytics.com>, Priya Reddy <priya.reddy@finlytics.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: security@finlytics.com, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-20T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff — initial availability (30/60 min options)

Thanks everyone — quick alignment note from Redwood:

- Confirmed kickoff: Wed 2026-10-20 09:00–10:30 PST (note: date moved one day to accommodate documentation turnaround).
- Action items (owners & due dates):
  * Ben: provide temporary test tenant details and an MS trial addendum template — due 2026-10-19 17:00 PST.
  * Monica: upload architecture diagram and network endpoints list to the Drive folder — due 2026-10-19 17:00 PST.
  * Evelyn: draft success-monitoring checklist (what metrics we’ll capture during the POC) and share with Adi — due 2026-10-19 17:00 PST.
  * Priya/Security: confirm if a 15-min security deep-dive inside the 90-min slot is acceptable or if you prefer a separate call — please reply by EOD 2026-10-19.

If any of these due dates are a problem we’ll pivot to Thu 2026-10-21 11:00–12:30 PST. I’ve attached the current POC success criteria (POC-success-criteria-v1.pdf) and a draft agenda link.

Meeting link will be shared once Ben confirms the test tenant details. Looking forward to getting this started — we’ll keep the kickoff tight and outcomes-focused.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Manager, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwoodinference.com
Attachments: POC-success-criteria-v1.pdf; draft-agenda-20261019.gdoc
